text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx/timeouts observed on /v1/generate from 18:03 UTC. P95 latency -> 3.2s (baseline 0.6s), P99 -> 9.8s. Error rate 5xx increased from 0.2% -> 4.5%. Paging oncall.

alex_w: seeing the same in dashboards. Canary deploy 18:00 by rollouts service. Rolling back now? :eyes:

marta_g: confirming traces show spikes in gateway timeouts calling runtime nodes. KV cache hits unchanged. Looks like request queuing in the new shader kernel path.

raj_p: rolling back canary to previous model variant (v2.14) now. Command:
```
rollout rollback --service=runtime-canary --to-tag=v2.14 --timeout=120
```

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by raj_p at 18:05 UTC. Canary traffic shifting to v2.14.

sam_k: quick note — we saw sustained token backlog on GPU-3 and GPU-7 during surge. KV cache warmups look fine. Suspect kernel selector choosing slower fallback for short sequences.

irene_s: customer-impact: CS reports 3 customers on Dedicated experiencing timeouts for inference jobs (multi-tenant). Putting them on incident watch and emailing SRE escalation list now.

alex_w: attaching representative logs from gateway:
```
[18:03:41] gateway: request_id=abc123 route=/v1/generate latency=10234ms upstream_timeout=true host=canary-node-07
[18:04:02] runtime: node=gpu-3 queue_depth=42 kernel=matrix_slow path=quant_run
[18:04:17] gateway: request_id=def456 error=502 upstream=runtime-canary
```

marta_g: repro steps locally: heavy short-seq workload + new kernel selector triggers CPU-copy path. On local perf test p99 jumps x8. Will force kernel_selector=legacy to confirm.

raj_p: rollback at 18:08 completed. Canary now at v2.14. Metrics starting to look better.

incident-bot: NOTE: Post-rollback monitoring window 30m started at 18:09 UTC.

sam_k: after rollback p95 back to 0.7s, p99 ~1.1s. 5xx down to 0.4%. Good but let's keep watch for regression flapping.

irene_s: sent initial customer update: "We observed elevated timeouts after a canary change at 18:00 UTC; we rolled back the canary at 18:08 UTC and are monitoring. We will follow up with root cause and ETA for fix." CS confirmed acknowledgement from impacted accounts.

marta_g: next steps: 1) create a test that simulates short-seq load to kernel selector. 2) revert kernel selector change in canary branch and add safety gate. 3) add circuit-breaker on queue depth > 30 to spill to legacy path.

alex_w: handing off to night oncall. @sam_k you'll be primary for the post-rollback watch. If errors rise >1% or p99>3s, page paging policy.

sam_k: ack. setting 1h alert slack pin and increasing scrape frequency for runtime nodes.

raj_p: capturing a quick data point for RCA: hash of canary deploy artifacts: sha256: b7f3...f2e9, kernel_selector commit 8d1c5. Creating PR to disable new selector on canary until tests are in.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (phase: mitigation). Root-cause analysis ticket created: INF-4321. Postmortem assigned to marta_g.
